card.subject: the mandatory pre-push security gate reports 0 alerts while 21 are open
card.activeForm: Making the pre-push security gate see every open alert

work_items: Add --paginate and a Dependabot half to the pre-push alert query
Sweep and repoint the copies of the broken query shape in other documents

card.description:
STATUS. Backfilled at the hydrostat adoption from specs/001-prepush-alert-visibility/spec.md (Draft, created 2026-07-31), which has a spec and no plan or tasks. Half the original defect was fixed in passing; both mechanisms below are still live.

THE GATE. Step 1 of the checklist this repo labels MANDATORY. It has certified a clean bill of health over its own repository for months, and the broken query shape was copied out of the checklist into other documents.

TWO INDEPENDENT MECHANISMS, EACH ALONE SUFFICIENT TO HIDE EVERYTHING.
1. Truncation. The endpoint pages and the query does not. The spec measured the original shape with NO per_page at all: default page 30, the 30 highest-numbered code-scanning alerts all happened to be `fixed`, so `select(.state == "open")` matched nothing and the command printed nothing and exited 0 while 5 were open. AGENTS.md:89 now carries per_page=100 but still no --paginate, so it truncates the moment the corpus exceeds one page. Measured 2026-09-22: the code-scanning corpus across all states is 156, which is already past 100.
2. An entire alert family is never queried. The section comment claims Dependabot coverage and the command hits only the code-scanning endpoint. Measured 2026-09-22: 21 Dependabot alerts are open and the gate reports 0 of them. The spec's own measurement on 2026-07-31 was 99 open Dependabot alerts against a gate printing 0.

REGENERATE BOTH CENSUSES rather than trusting the numbers above; they are as of 2026-09-22 and move with every dependabot PR:
gh api 'repos/traylorre/sentiment-analyzer-gsk/dependabot/alerts?state=open&per_page=100' --paginate --jq length
gh api 'repos/traylorre/sentiment-analyzer-gsk/code-scanning/alerts?per_page=100' --paginate --jq length

WHAT REMAINS. Fix the query shape in AGENTS.md to add --paginate and a Dependabot half, then sweep the copies the spec says were made into other documents and repoint them. The spec notes the five hidden alerts included three that a then-in-flight feature existed to close, which is a plausible account of how they sat open for months while the documented process was followed.

status.summary: Both work items are closed. The alert query now lives in scripts/check_security_alerts.py, run as make check-security-alerts. It reads every page of code scanning and Dependabot alerts via gh api --paginate --slurp, anchors the read on corpus floors (156, 208), the state vocabulary and every field it prints, and gives CLEAN, FINDINGS or COULD-NOT-DETERMINE. Live today: code scanning 0 open of 156, Dependabot 28 open of 208, FINDINGS. Three live mutants (mistyped field path, mistyped state field, single-page fetch) and an unauthenticated run each give COULD-NOT-DETERMINE. make check-alert-query-copies reports any tracked file outside specs/, cards/ and docs/archive/ that restates the query, and anchors on the script. The sweep repointed AGENTS.md and docs/cleanup-pristine/milestone-1-verifiable-auth.md. Neither target is in make validate or a hook. 32 unit tests; 7 anchor mutants each fail at least one. make validate and make test-unit pass. Record: specs/1402-prepush-alert-visibility/ (spec, plan, tasks, evidence).
for_the_board: NEW CARD raised: cards/NEW-card-10-dependabot-backlog.json, 28 open Dependabot alerts (3 critical, all in next in frontend/package-lock.json). origin is pre-existing, evidence is make check-security-alerts. Helios assigns the id and places it in goal.json.

OPERATOR DECISION, gating, two separate calls. (1) make check-alert-query-copies as a BLOCKING stage of make validate: card #10 recommends yes. It is offline and deterministic, reports 0 findings over 1096 tracked files today, and exits 2 rather than passing if it cannot see the script. (2) make check-security-alerts as a blocking pre-push or CI step: card #10 recommends not yet. It reports FINDINGS today (28 open Dependabot alerts), so it would block every push until the NEW card above clears them. It also needs network and gh auth, and it fails closed (COULD-NOT-DETERMINE, exit 2) on any outage. No false FINDINGS were seen: every alert it lists has state open via the anchored path. Through make, both failures exit 2, so a CI wrapper must read the VERDICT line or call the script directly (exit 1 findings, 2 could not determine).
ROOT CHECKOUT: the untracked specs/001-prepush-alert-visibility/ is superseded by specs/1402-prepush-alert-visibility/ once this lands; Helios said it deletes it then.

CARD #9: specs/ dirs hold about 40 copies of the alert query, some unpaginated. The copy scan excludes specs/ by Helios's ruling, so they remain for card #9's sweep. Regenerate the list with: git grep -n -E '(code-scanning|dependabot)/alerts' -- specs

FLOORS: the corpus floors in scripts/check_security_alerts.py are the 2026-10-10 sizes. A floor failure means a fetch that stopped early unless the corpus was reset. The module docstring gives the revision procedure (--print-corpus).
FYI: create-new-feature.sh is absent from this repo's .specify/scripts/bash/. The dotfiles copy minted spec 1402 from the card's specNumber, as approved.
